title: Supercharge Your Telegram with AI: Meet the Telegram MCP Server!
contentMarkdown:
## 📝 Quick Summary: 
Telegram MCP Server is a Python-based server that bridges Telegram with Model Context Protocol (MCP) compatible clients like Claude and Cursor. It allows these clients to interact with Telegram features such as reading chats, managing groups, sending and modifying messages, and handling media and contacts.

## 🔑 Key Takeaways

- ✅ Integrates Telegram directly with AI models like Claude and Cursor via the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

- ✅ Offers over 80 tools for comprehensive Telegram management, including accounts, chats, messages, and contacts.

- ✅ Enables AI to automate tasks like summarizing chats, sending messages, managing groups, and searching history.

- ✅ Features 'remembered contacts' for personalized communication, allowing AI to understand user-defined aliases.

- ✅ Significantly boosts productivity by streamlining Telegram interactions with intelligent automation.


## 📊 Project Statistics
- ⭐ Stars: 1662
- 🍴 Forks: 430
- ❗ Open Issues: 14


## 🛠 Tech Stack
- ✅ Python


Hey fellow developers! Ever wished your AI assistant could truly understand and interact with your Telegram chats, not just as a separate entity, but as a seamless extension of your workflow? Well, get ready to have your mind blown, because I just stumbled upon a GitHub project that does exactly that: the Telegram MCP Server! This isn't just another bot; it's a game-changer for anyone who lives in Telegram and wants to harness the power of AI like Claude or Cursor.

So, what exactly is this magic? At its core, the Telegram MCP Server acts as a brilliant bridge, connecting your Telegram account directly to AI models via something called the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Think of MCP as a universal language that lets AI tools talk to external services. Instead of manually sifting through messages, creating groups, or even scheduling replies, you can now simply ask your AI to do it for you. It leverages the robust Telethon library to expose a massive array of Telegram functionalities – we're talking over 80 different tools!

Imagine this: you ask Claude, 'Summarize my last conversation with Sarah and then draft a polite follow-up message.' Done. Or, 'Find all messages from the 'Project Alpha' group mentioning 'deadline' in the last week.' It's like having a super-smart personal assistant dedicated solely to your Telegram. The project covers everything from managing your accounts and chats (creating groups, inviting users, setting permissions) to handling messages (sending, editing, deleting, even sophisticated rich formatting if you have Telegram Premium!) and contacts (listing, searching, adding, and even remembering contacts by the names *you* actually use, thanks to a clever alias feature).

The benefits for us developers are huge. This project dramatically boosts productivity by automating repetitive tasks and enabling complex, context-aware interactions. No more switching apps or copy-pasting; your AI can now directly manage your Telegram presence. The 'remembered contacts' feature is particularly brilliant – you teach the server what you call someone, and your AI understands it from then on, making communication feel incredibly natural and personalized. Whether you're a solo developer managing project communications or part of a larger team, integrating this can streamline your workflow significantly. This isn't just about convenience; it's about unlocking a new level of intelligent interaction with one of our most essential communication tools. You absolutely need to check this out and see how it can transform your Telegram experience!
